editorial_thesis: Today’s strongest signals move agent design toward explicit state, bounded execution, and reviewable evidence: the system should remember what changed, operate against fresh context without risking production, and ask better questions before it acts.

topic_groups.title: Security Delivery Moves Into the Pull Request
topic_groups.selection_rationale: GitHub’s newest security loop is reviewable remediation, not autonomous merging.

sources.title: AI Scan for pull requests
sources.why_selected: It expands the security net into PHP, shell, Terraform, Dockerfiles, JSP, Blazor, and other gaps, but findings remain advisory and consume Code Security AI Credits.
sources.usefulness: Offer a client baseline that combines CodeQL, AI Scan, explicit advisory labeling, and a budget owner.

sources.title: Agentic autofix for code scanning alerts
sources.why_selected: The validation loop is the important primitive: an agent does not merely write a patch; it tests whether the alert closes.
sources.usefulness: Turn findings into a repeatable artifact: alert → patch → CodeQL result → draft PR → named approver.

sources.title: Code Quality usage as CSV
sources.why_selected: License and AI spend become reconcilable with internal records instead of remaining inside a vendor dashboard.
sources.usefulness: Add vendor-usage exports to Buildn delivery reviews and cost attribution.

sources.title: AI Scan metrics in Security Overview
sources.why_selected: A portfolio view is needed to distinguish adoption, coverage, alert quality, and credit consumption.
sources.usefulness: Use the metrics as an input to a client security scorecard rather than reporting raw alert counts.

topic_groups.title: Agent-Ready Data: Fresh Context Without Production Risk
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Database isolation and structured analytics skills make agent context safer to operate.

sources.title: PostgreSQL for agents in AlloyDB
sources.why_selected: It addresses the hard production problem: agents create bursty, unpredictable queries that should not compete with mission-critical workloads.
sources.usefulness: Use the pattern in client architecture reviews: isolated agent compute, current data, least-privilege access, and pay-per-use economics.

sources.title: BigQuery augmented analytics TVFs
sources.why_selected: Structured outputs make analytics more composable as agent skills than a free-form dashboard or opaque notebook.
sources.usefulness: Create an agent skill that runs a fixed diagnostic sequence, returns SQL-backed evidence, and asks for approval before narrative synthesis.

sources.title: Native AlloyDB hybrid search + RRF
sources.why_selected: One engine for lexical and semantic retrieval reduces synchronization and operational seams in RAG systems.
sources.usefulness: Evaluate whether a client can replace a split vector/search stack with a Postgres-native retrieval boundary.

sources.title: Agent-ready Data Cloud direction
sources.why_selected: Agent quality is increasingly constrained by context access and data freshness rather than model selection.
sources.usefulness: Make data readiness a first-class line item in Buildn discovery: authority, freshness, joinability, and safe query surfaces.

topic_groups.title: Memory Quality Is State Tracking, Not Recall
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Professional memory needs authority and change tracking; learning benefits from questions and recall.

sources.title: DSV-Mem: professional visual memory benchmark
sources.why_selected: The strongest baseline reaches only 39.6% overall accuracy; 89.7% of errors come from state reconstruction.
sources.usefulness: Model Buildn artifacts as versioned evidence with authority, supersession, and refusal states—not a flat embedding store.

sources.title: MemPilot: on-demand multimodal memory curation
sources.why_selected: It treats memory as a runtime budget decision and preserves raw history for details that compression may discard.
sources.usefulness: Prototype a two-tier memory policy: cheap index first, targeted evidence recovery only when confidence or provenance is weak.

sources.title: Study Mode: learning through questions
sources.why_selected: The interaction pattern favors active participation and metacognition over answer delivery.
sources.usefulness: Use it for personal learning and client enablement: one question at a time, evidence of reasoning, and a final recall task without the transcript.

sources.title: Self-ledger memory pattern
sources.why_selected: A compact ledger can make contradictions visible before they become confident but stale answers.
sources.usefulness: Add event rows to long-running work: timestamp, source, field changed, previous value, new value, authority, status.
